title: Origin story: Skadi
description: Skadi was a giantess, daughter of Thiazi, who came to Asgard in full armor demanding weregild for her slain father. The gods offered her marriage to one of their own — choosing by feet alone — and she chose Njord, only to find she could not bear his sea. She returned to her mountains, bow in hand, and married Ullr the hunter instead.
